claim: L'Ambroisie dropped from three stars to two in the 2026 Michelin Guide following founder Bernard Pacaud's retirement in July 2025; new chef Shintaro Awa now leads under owner Walter Butler.
quote: L'Ambroisie maintained three Michelin stars from 1988 until 2026 ... Chef Shintaro Awa stepping in to lead the culinary team.

claim: Nine three-star restaurants in Paris for 2026: Kei, Plénitude, Arpège, Alléno Paris au Pavillon Ledoyen, Épicure, Le Cinq, Le Gabriel, Pierre Gagnaire, Le Pré Catelan.
quote: Kei (2020), Plénitude (2022), Arpège (1996), Alléno Paris (2002), Épicure (2009), Le Cinq (2016), Le Gabriel (2024), Pierre Gagnaire (1998), Le Pré Catelan (2007).

claim: Four new two-star promotions in Paris and Île-de-France for 2026: Virtus (12e), Hakuba (Cheval Blanc, 1er), Alliance (5e), Le Corot (Ville-d'Avray).
quote: Virtus (Paris 12e) ... Hakuba (Cheval Blanc Paris) ... Le Corot ... Alliance — Newly promoted.

claim: Restaurant Guy Savoy was demoted from three stars to two in the 2023 Michelin Guide and remains at two stars.
quote: Guy Savoy's Monnaie de Paris restaurant was downgraded from three stars to two stars in the 2023 edition of the Michelin Guide France.

claim: Restaurant Le Meurice Alain Ducasse currently holds two Michelin stars, with executive chef Amaury Bouhours operating under Alain Ducasse's direction.
quote: presents a two-Michelin-starred experience ... overseen by Alain Ducasse with executive chef Amaury Bouhours.

claim: Kei tasting menus run from €185 (Découverte, Fri/Sat lunch only) through Dégustation €280, Prestige €380, Horizon €450 to Grand Horizon €560.
quote: Découverte Menu for €185 (Friday and Saturday lunch only), Dégustation €280, Prestige €380, Horizon €450, Grand Horizon €560.

claim: Kei Kobayashi was the first Japanese chef to earn three Michelin stars in France, awarded in 2020 and maintained through 2026.
quote: Kei Kobayashi, who made history as the first Japanese chef to ever earn three Michelin stars in France.

claim: Plénitude is a 3-star restaurant at Cheval Blanc Paris by Chef Arnaud Donckele with 26 seats overlooking the Seine; two menus 'Fuguons ensemble' (4 acts) and 'Symphonie' (6 acts).
quote: 3-star MICHELIN gastronomic restaurant by Chef Arnaud Donckele ... 26 seats ... Fuguons ensemble in 4 acts and Symphonie in 6 acts.

claim: L'Arpège, three-star restaurant of Chef Alain Passard, is built around produce from three of his own gardens delivered daily.
quote: Official website of L'Arpège, three-star restaurant of Chef Alain Passard.

claim: Arpège menus: Gardeners' Lunch €175, Vegetable Tasting ~€360, Earth & Sea Tasting €420 evening; lunch menu €145 noted as comparative bargain to €380 dinner tasting.
quote: Gardeners' Lunch menu costs €175, The Vegetable Tasting is €360 ... evening Earth and Sea tasting menu costs €420.

claim: Pavillon Ledoyen (8e, off the Champs-Élysées) houses Alléno Paris (3 stars), L'Abysse (2 stars), and Pavyllon (1 star) — the world's most Michelin-starred independent establishment under Yannick Alléno since 2014.
quote: Alléno Paris***, L'Abysse**, and Pavyllon Paris* ... Chef Yannick Alléno settled here in 2014, creating the most Michelin-starred independent establishment in the world.

claim: Arnaud Faye, Meilleur Ouvrier de France 2019, took over Épicure at Le Bristol in 2024 from Éric Frechon, maintaining its three Michelin stars.
quote: Arnaud Faye is the Executive Chef of the Three-MICHELIN-Star Épicure and Head of Kitchens at Le Bristol ... succeeding chef Éric Frechon, who was at the hotel for 25 years.

claim: Épicure is the 3-Michelin-star fine-dining restaurant at Le Bristol Paris (8e, near the Élysée), overlooking the hotel's French garden.
quote: Epicure | 3-Michelin Star Restaurant in Paris | Le Bristol Paris.

claim: Le Cinq is the restaurant of the Four Seasons Hôtel George V (8e), led by Chef Christian Le Squer with three Michelin stars since 2016.
quote: Le Cinq Restaurant: Four Seasons Hotel George V Paris.

claim: Le Cinq offers à la carte or a 10-course tasting menu; lunch with wine ~€315; dress code includes formal jacket; open Tue–Sat lunch 12:30–14:00 and dinner 19:00–21:30.
quote: 10-course tasting menu ... Lunch with wine costs around €315 ... open Tuesday to Saturday from 12:30 to 2:00 PM for lunch, and from 7:00 to 9:30 PM for dinner.

claim: Le Gabriel is the 3-star restaurant at La Réserve Paris (8e), led by Chef Jérôme Banctel with two tasting menus: 'Virée' (Brittany) and 'Périple' (global / Japan / Turkey).
quote: Restaurant Le Gabriel | 3 Michelin Star Restaurant in Paris ... 'Virée', a tribute to his native Brittany, and 'Périple'.

claim: Le Gabriel's four-course Escale lunch menu is €148, with a shorter four-course at €98 — among the better-value entry points to a Paris three-star room.
quote: Le Gabriel at La Réserve Paris Review: €148 Three-Star Lunch ... four-course Escale menu at 148 € felt like a precise lens on a three star kitchen.

claim: Pierre Gagnaire (6 Rue Balzac, 8e) offers a €90 three-course lunch menu and a €370 evening tasting menu; closed all day Sat–Sun.
quote: three-course lunch menu for €90 ... evening menu is 370€ ... closed all day on Saturdays and Sundays.

claim: Le Pré Catelan is set in a Napoleon III lodge in the Bois de Boulogne (16e) with three Michelin stars; menu at €250 with wine pairing, lunch menu not available Saturdays or holidays; Chef Frédéric Anton since 1997.
quote: A menu is available at the retail price of 250 Euros with a selection of wine by Boris Thuillier. The lunch menu is not available on Saturdays and public holidays.

claim: Restaurant David Toutain (7e, near Les Invalides) offers four surprise tasting menus from €108 (Alliaire) to €258 (Reine des Prés); wine pairings €88–€238.
quote: Menu Alliaire at €108, Menu Berce at €168, Menu Mélisse at €198, and Menu Reine des Prés at €258.

claim: Alliance is the 2-star restaurant of Toshitaka Omiya and Shawn Joyeux between the Left Bank and Boulevard Saint-Germain (5e); intimate seven-table dining room.
quote: Restaurant Alliance · Restaurant with 2 Michelin stars Paris.

claim: Alliance was awarded its second Michelin star in the 2026 guide; Osaka-born chef Toshitaka Omiya previously trained at L'Arpège and the George V.
quote: Alliance was recently awarded a second Michelin star, making it one of seven new Two-Star restaurants in the 2026 Michelin Guide.

claim: Le Clarence is the 2-star restaurant in a private mansion near the Champs-Élysées (8e), part of Domaine Clarence Dillon (Château Haut-Brion).
quote: Le Clarence ... at the initiative of the family-owned group Domaine Clarence Dillon, owner of prestigious wine estates including the legendary Château Haut-Brion.

claim: Le Clarence retained its two Michelin stars in 2026 under new Executive Chef Andrea Capasso, who took over in September 2025.
quote: Le Clarence Awarded Two Michelin Stars Under the Direction of Andrea Capasso ... Capasso became Executive Chef in September 2025.

claim: La Scène (32 Avenue Matignon, 8e) is the 2-star restaurant of Stéphanie Le Quellec; menus across 3, 4, or 7 'acts' from €145–€355; open Mon–Fri lunch 12:30 and dinner 19:30.
quote: Site Officiel - La Scène - Stéphanie Le Quellec - 2* Guide Michelin ... open Monday to Friday from 12:30-13:30 for lunch and 19:30-20:45 for dinner.

claim: Hakuba at Cheval Blanc Paris is a kaiseki-sushi collaboration of Donckele, Watanabe and Maxime Frédéric; lunch 'Shunkan' €180 Thu–Sat, dinner 'Yume' €420 Tue–Sat evenings, supplements for sea urchin temaki (+€30) and truffle (+€95).
quote: Hakuba Restaurant – Michelin-Starred Japanese Restaurant at Cheval Blanc Paris.

claim: Hakuba was promoted to two Michelin stars in 2026.
quote: Arnaud Donckele, Takuya Watanabe et Maxime Frédéric décrochent une 2ème étoile Michelin à Hakuba.

claim: The 2026 Michelin Guide France & Monaco selection was announced on 16 March 2026; 84 restaurants recommended with two Michelin stars nationwide.
quote: The new restaurant selection was announced on Monday March 16, 2026 ... 84 restaurants are recommended with Two MICHELIN Stars in the 2026 selection.

claim: Mojju (4 Rue de l'Exposition, 7e) is a Korean-French 2-star by chef Thibault Sombardier; charcoal-grilled matured meats and marinated fish with banchan and ssam.
quote: Mojju is a Korean restaurant in Paris opened by Chef Thibault Sombardier ... barbecued over charcoal, the matured meats and marinated fish are served alongside traditional banchan.
